detail.longDescription: 🤖 NEW: Engineers at the University of # Pennsylvania built an artificial muscle from a rubbery liquid crystal elastomer reinforced with # graphene and threaded with an ultrathin copper coil. Because heating makes the material contract, the coil doubles as heater and sensor, keeping the # muscle at a fixed length. Additionally, a # robot hand played # piano keys at varied force, and robotic # eyes held a gaze. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/technology/artifici al-muscles-humanoid-robot-play-piano/ # engineering # materials # robotics # science # tech # technology # humanoids # muscles # research
